save_branch.modified_name_rule: contains .1, not an exact suffix test
save_branch.wrapper_semantics: Forwards only the supplied property names/values; no global Orientation or Color append.

modified_slot.semantics: Changed property on a name without '.1': reuse/create name+'.1', copy 12 source values into a 13-element row, edit the returned slot, make it active. Existing modified slots are reused.
modified_slot.iso_ui_path_status: Generic dialog path not completely mapped in this bounded audit; ISO is model column 2 in SaveShootSetup, but no invented UI clone call is asserted.

prefix_support.semantics: Global flag set when a ShootSetup Prefix or ICCFlag key is parsed; not a separate Sync PrefixSupport attribute.

framing.semantics: Semicolon list of comma-separated records, exactly name plus four integer values; only the name belongs in ShootSetup.Framing.

notes: Requires already-synchronized state; no per-write pre-Sync in this function.
On transport failure while still synchronized, original code may ReSync and retry. This is historical behavior, not a recommendation to automatically repeat state-changing commands.
Directory wrapper forwards exactly the supplied property array; it does not append global Orientation/Color.

receive_routing.semantics: Pending reply matched by command ID; Error is accepted separately; PictureTaken is asynchronous. No transaction ID was established.

remaining_limits: No physical Valeo setting write or Bluetooth capture was performed.
